design: Additive change of the orchestrator only (LOCAL-SUITE-SPLIT-REACTIVATION point 6): scripts/run_qualifying_campaign.py, the workflows, the CI parts and their limits are unchanged.
LANE_COUNT 4 and ADMITTED_LANE_COUNTS (4, 2): partition, exact union, supervision, results, JUnit merge, coverage and teardown work on the lane count admitted at start.

Three admission levels with the REM-0037 rule (lanes x 5670.3 MiB + the unchanged 3000 MiB guard): FOUR_LANE >= 25681.2 MiB, TWO_LANE >= 14340.6 MiB (unchanged), else SERIAL recorded; the campaign result records admission_level, lanes_admitted and lanes_run; the caps 5400/3600/5100 s apply to the whole campaign.

--lifecycle-check provisions the lanes, starts their private daemons, bootstraps every stack in parallel, reads the typed probe of every service and measures per lane the bootstrap time and the Temporal SERVING delay since its container start, then tears down with zero residue.

Every parsing path of the orchestrator reads its input without conversion (strict UTF-8, ASCII digits, finite non-bool numbers) and refuses anything else with the typed CampaignError or the recorded serial fallback; every process and watcher is stopped on every error path.

dispositions.summary: memory_admission reads MemTotal and MemAvailable each exactly once as ASCII digits with the kB unit (anything else is the recorded SERIAL); read_memory_admission decodes meminfo as strict UTF-8 and records an unreadable or undecodable file as SERIAL in lifecycle_check, execute_campaign and --plan

bootstrap_summary refuses NaN and Infinity, a negative or non-numeric provisioning time, a typed status other than PASS or FAIL or inconsistent with the services, and empty service names or states; StartedAt accepts ASCII digits only; the lane bootstrap log is decoded as strict UTF-8 and an undecodable log is a typed FAIL of the lane

load_lane_spec takes a JSON object with exactly its five keys, checks element types before hashing and a finite non-bool start (run_lane then writes a typed FAIL result); read_lane_results takes an object with int lane and selected and a boolean po_decision_required; the stored copy in execute_campaign records a corrupted result as unreadable and never masks the typed failure

stop_process translates kill and wait failures (TimeoutExpired, OSError); bootstrap_lanes stops every remaining bootstrap, releases and joins every watcher, then raises one typed error naming the failure and every lane that did not stop; supervise_lanes does the same for lanes; lifecycle_check and execute_campaign catch SubprocessError

negative tests for every parsing path named and for the whole orchestrator class (weights, JUnit times, tools lock, power supply, stop request, env file), then the command runner (RED c82d696, GREEN de79d98: output decoded as strict UTF-8); input-robustness table rewritten for every parsing path
a Temporal probe that cannot run or times out is a poll without SERVING counted in probe_errors and no longer ends the watch; the per-lane bootstrap record is FAIL whenever the lane is rejected

residual_risks: Every lane's private dockerd starts empty and pulls each pinned image from its registry: a four-lane campaign costs about four times the Docker Hub pulls of a serial one, and the unauthenticated limit of this host's address is 100 pulls per hour; a four-lane run right after another pulling run can fail at setup with 429 (the diagnostic attempt of this unit). Counter-measure applied: one pulling campaign per hour; a pull-through cache or seeding the lanes from the host image store (digest-pinned) would remove the risk and is a separate decision.
Not runtime conformance, not BA/FGM evidence, never evidence of a requirement.
